item.description: This was an interesting concept for a collab, it was my first time finding out about the 'eastern' version of this collab concept and it's just a great idea and very interesting to just see how people whose videos i find incredibly cool are doing in their life

item.title: underwater.avi - Production Journal
item.description: Around three days ago, I found "What A Hacker's Astral Observatory Looks Like", which I thought looked really beautiful. Then, Junki sent this video by Lorne on Discord, and both grounded a lot of the visual ideas I would incorporate. For example, the CRT monitor playing the sample being recorded physically is something I've wanted to try out for a while - inspired by Darwin's "Project: Doomsday" (who is a big inspiration to me in general).

item.title: Writing A Blog Framework Is Surprisingly Easy
item.description: A part of changing my blog philosophy was realizing that i don't really care about reading other peoples diaries (Unless they're like really interesting, or something) and generally all written media i read has themes and something to say, so i'm glad to say i'm heading to a more essay-like blog where i just write about my projects, or any topic that comes to mind.
